en: It is easy in the world to live after the world's opinion; it is easy in solitude to live after our own; but the great man is he who in the midst of the crowd keeps with perfect sweetness the independence of solitude.
zh: 隨波逐流、依世俗眼光度日並不難；獨處時依著自己的意見生活，也非難事；然而真正的偉人，是那種即使身處人群之中，仍能以從容自在的姿態，堅守獨處時才有的那份獨立精神的人。
